immutability.rule: After this freeze, these protocol artifacts and thresholds MUST NOT be edited. A prospective replacement version requires separate governance before any observation; after the first observation, this version remains immutable evidence and no replacement may alter interpretation of its observations.

required_history_statements: Phase 5-4 did not pass its original two-human qualification gate.
Phase 5-5 proceeded under explicit owner governance override.
retained_findings: R-J Y507 genuine individual comprehension error
governance.residual_accepted_risk: R-J Y507 genuine individual comprehension error

evaluates: reviewer operation of the already-frozen review workflow

observation_unit: Exactly one review item presented to one PRIMARY_REVIEWER through the frozen review workflow, together with its source evidence, system classification, guard state, quality state, recorded reviewer disposition, applicable acknowledgement state, review timing, correction/disagreement record, and attributable maintenance impact. A raw fetch, source page, campground, or scheduler run alone is not an observation. A secondary review is part of the same observation, not a new observation.

cohort.null_event_category_rule: Quality-only observations retain event_category null and make no semantic event claim; no category may be added by this protocol.

observation_window.activation: A separate Phase 5-5C execution-readiness authorization records pilot_started_at in UTC; no observation may precede it.
observation_window.calendar_boundary: 14 consecutive 24-hour periods from pilot_started_at, ending at pilot_started_at plus 336 hours.
observation_window.completion_condition: Normal collection ends immediately at the earlier of 100 structurally valid prospective observations or pilot_started_at plus 336 hours. An immediate STOP or repeated-error HOLD ends collection earlier.
observation_window.historical_data_use: Context only; never counted as a pilot observation or pilot metric denominator.

reviewer_model.identity_model: Exactly two authorized internal reviewers use stable blinded codes PRIMARY_REVIEWER and SECOND_REVIEWER; one separate OWNER_ADJUDICATOR uses a stable code. A sealed owner-held mapping binds each code to one human before execution and may not change during the pilot.
reviewer_model.routine_review: PRIMARY_REVIEWER independently reviews every item once through the frozen workflow.
reviewer_model.secondary_review: SECOND_REVIEWER independently reviews only the prospectively selected control sample without seeing the primary disposition, correction, or outcome.
reviewer_model.adjudication: OWNER_ADJUDICATOR resolves structured incompatibility and disagreement classification using frozen facts and contract. Adjudication preserves both original reviews and cannot rewrite them.

control_sample.method: Assign each eligible observation an immutable one-based intake_sequence before primary review. Select intake_sequence values divisible by 5 (5, 10, 15, ...).
control_sample.completion: Every selected item admitted before collection ends must receive an independent secondary review and bounded adjudication before normal closeout.

y507_control.contract: For any unguarded item with relevance_status UNKNOWN and quality_defect_basis NONE, DATA_QUALITY_HOLD is not valid merely because relevance is UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN remains distinct from DATA_QUALITY and runtime semantics are unchanged.
y507_control.derivation: TRUE if and only if relevance_status == UNKNOWN AND quality_defect_basis == NONE AND reviewer_disposition == DATA_QUALITY_HOLD; otherwise FALSE.

disposition_comprehension_error_rate.numerator: Count of pilot observations with confirmed_structured_disposition_incompatibility == true after bounded adjudication. Each observation contributes at most one, even if multiple error classes apply.
disposition_comprehension_error_rate.denominator: Count of pilot observations for which reviewer_disposition is non-null and recorded by PRIMARY_REVIEWER.
disposition_comprehension_error_rate.rate: numerator / denominator; report NOT_MEASURABLE when denominator is zero.

metrics.error_classification_rule: Every confirmed comprehension error maps to at least one frozen class. Classes are not renamed, relaxed, or silently recategorized after observations begin.

disagreement.rate: disagreement count / independently double-reviewed observation count; NOT_MEASURABLE when denominator is zero.

correction: whether correction occurred before any downstream state transition
metrics.correction_rule: A corrected human error remains counted; correction never erases the original event.
guard: guarded items initially routed to permitted hold/follow-up disposition
acknowledgement: inappropriate assumptions that acknowledgement implies safety, notification approval, or semantic resolution
metrics.workload_separation: Ordinary reviewer operating time, system/source operational maintenance, and development/debugging are reported separately.

maintenance.included: Only OPERATIONAL_MAINTENANCE attributable to keeping the pilot functioning.
maintenance.report: weekly operational maintenance minutes, record count, category/source-authority breakdown, and COMPLETE/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN status

interpretation_rules: One isolated contained reviewer error does not automatically constitute system-safety failure.
Allowed discretionary reviewer choices are not errors.
UNKNOWN/DATA_QUALITY confusion is counted only when structured facts contradict the selected disposition/classification.
Guard bypass is more severe than ordinary disposition disagreement.
Any unsafe inference is separately reported and cannot be averaged away.
Product/runtime defects, source/retrieval defects, reviewer comprehension defects, and maintenance burden are separate result dimensions.
PASS, HOLD, or STOP is rule-based; no percentage alone determines the decision.
Source silence never establishes safety or semantic resolution.
Acknowledgement never implies safety, notification approval, or semantic resolution.
Guarded failure never establishes semantic resolution.
immediate_stop_conditions: notification or delivery becomes enabled or invoked
guard bypass permits a prohibited direct disposition or lifecycle transition
reviewer workflow generates or endorses a trip-safety claim
reviewer workflow generates or endorses a road-passability claim
source silence is treated as evidence of safety or semantic resolution
a system-generated false lifecycle event reaches the review layer as accepted truth without containment
protocol or observation data are materially corrupted such that pilot validity cannot be determined

repeated_error_triggers.independence: distinct review_item_id occurrences; duplicate/superseding records for one item count once
distinct review_item_id occurrences across the combined boundary category

isolated_y507_rule: Do not STOP on the first isolated UNKNOWN/DATA_QUALITY error when it is contained in review, causes no prohibited downstream action, and is corrected/adjudicated; count it and continue unless another rule requires STOP/HOLD.

authorization_boundary.this_checkpoint: Protocol design freeze only; it may authorize a separate Phase 5-5C execution-readiness checkpoint but does not start the pilot.
